entities.summary: Katherine Briana "Khat" Bell is an American volleyball player who currently plays for the LOVB Austin of LOVB Pro. Bell played for the Petron Blaze Spikers in the Philippine Super Liga from 2018 to 2020. and for Korea Expressway Corporation Hi-Pass in the Korean V-League in 2024.
